class.name: Simulation3D
class.brief_description: A container for a space and scenario, for use in [i]The Conservatory[/i].
class.description:
[Simulation3D] is a specialzied class designed explicitly for [i]The Conservatory[/i]. It is similar to [SubViewport] in that it has its own space and scenario (for physics and rendering respectively), but it is strictly controlled by the engine. All attempts to manage this object yourself will crash the game. You are expected to use its properties, and nothing more. The only class that can create new instances of this type is The Fabric of Reality.
This class cannot be used in [code]GDScript[/code].

method.name: get_is_live
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this instance is valid and can be used.

method.name: get_physics_space
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the physical space for this [Scenario3D]. Physical objects for this simulation should have their space set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: get_render_scenario
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the render scenario for this [Scenario3D]. Rendered objects for this simulation should have their scenario set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Destroys this instance like [method Free], but validates that it is acceptable to do so. [b]DANGER:[/b] [i]Never[/i] [code]free()[/code] a [Simulation3D], or remove it as a child from the scene tree, or call this method without first destroying the corresponding [code]WorldInstance[/code] (a class in [i]The Conservatory[/i]). Failure to follow this warning will crash the game.

method.name: set_conservatory_callbacks
method.description: [b]DANGER:[/b] This is strictly for internal use by [i]The Conservatory[/i]'s scene tree type, [i]The Fabric of Reality[/i]. Attempting to use this yourself will crash the game.
